decision.rationale: TXN-007990 is an 8.38 EUR charge on card CRD-000240 at Harbour Media (MER-000008), a merchant that bills on a recurring basis. The charge was made on 2026-09-28 and posted on 2026-09-29. The dispute was opened on 2026-10-24, 25 days after posting, so it is within the 120-day limit in time-limits. The cardholder says they cancelled by phone and has nothing in writing. No documents are attached, so there is no cancellation confirmation from the merchant. That means there is no effective cancellation date to compare with the 2026-09-28 charge date. Under recurring-no-proof, we must ask the merchant for its cancellation records and its terms for the subscription.

proposed_actions.note: Please send your cancellation records for this card's subscription, including any record of a cancellation request made by phone and the date it took effect, and the subscription terms that applied to the 8.38 EUR charge made on 2026-09-28.
